# `aitbc agent-comm network`

Get an overview of the cross-chain agent network and distribution.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm network [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm network
```
